import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, breed_counts.values)):
    ax1.text(count + bar.get_width()*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=8)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(district_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(district_counts.values, labels=district_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors,
                                   textprops={'fontsize': 8})
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Dog age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_order = df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique()
age_order = sorted(age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Gender distribution of dogs
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['lightcoral', 'lightblue']
wedges2, texts2, autotexts2 = ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                      autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_gender,
                                      textprops={'fontsize': 9})
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Dog registrations over years
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax5.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6)
ax5.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3)
ax5.set_xlabel('Year')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations')
ax5.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Owner age groups
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.barh(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax6.set_yticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Owners')
ax6.set_title('Dog Owners by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, count in enumerate(owner_age_counts.values):
    ax6.text(count + count*0.01, i, f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=8)

# 7. Top dog colors
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(8)
bars3 = ax7.bar(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values, color='goldenrod', edgecolor='brown')
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(color_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax7.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax7.set_title('Most Common Dog Colors', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, count in zip(bars3, color_counts.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax7.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + height*0.01,
             f'{count:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 8. Mixed vs pure breed distribution
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
df['IsMixed'] = df['Rasse2Text'].notna()
mixed_counts = df['IsMixed'].value_counts()
labels_mixed = ['Pure Breed', 'Mixed Breed']
colors_mixed = ['lightblue', 'lightcoral']
wedges3, texts3, autotexts3 = ax8.pie(mixed_counts.values, labels=labels_mixed, 
                                       autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_mixed,
                                       textprops={'fontsize': 9})
ax8.set_title('Pure vs Mixed Breed Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Dogs per owner (AnzHunde distribution)
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
dogs_per_owner = df['AnzHunde'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax9.bar(dogs_per_owner.index, dogs_per_owner.values, color='orchid', edgecolor='purple', alpha=0.7)
ax9.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs per Owner')
ax9.set_ylabel('Count')
ax9.set_title('Distribution of Dogs per Owner', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for x, y in zip(dogs_per_owner.index, dogs_per_owner.values):
    ax9.text(x, y + y*0.01, f'{y:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis: Breed, Demographics and Distribution Patterns', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
